name: Juniper Hotels Ltd
about: Incorporated in September 1985, Juniper Hotels Limited is a luxury hotel development and ownership company.[1] The company’s portfolio comprises seven hotels with 1836 keys (including 245 serviced apartments) across strategic locations in India.
keyPoints:
Property Portfolio[1]
Juniper Hotels operates a luxury hotel chain under the Hyatt brand and owns 19.6% of the Hyatt group-affiliated hotel rooms and apartments in India. Their portfolio includes 8 hotel assets as of FY25, with 2,115 keys

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 22.9% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 1.42% over last 3 years.
